title: MineFoundry
description: Friendly survival server with many custom plugins and features, such as auto-crop harvesters, mob drop collectors, in-game ranks and perks, economy, homes, claims, player warps and personal vaults, grief protection, etc. Best of all, it's 100% FREE.
body:
# MineFoundry - mf.mc.gg

New, friendly Survival server with lots of custom features:
- economy, player shops and marketplace
- claims, grief protection, homes and player warps
- custom PVP Arena and mob grinders where you earn cash!
- custom auto-crop Harvesters for farming
- custom drop-collectors for mob farms
- In-game ranks and perks

... the best part, it's **FREE to play**, not PAY-to-win! Ranks and perks are earned in-game, not bought for $$$!

## Connect

▶️ **Play**: [mf.mc.gg](https://mf.mc.gg/)

🖥️ **Discord**: [discord.gg/e9j3nTHqPn](https://discord.gg/e9j3nTHqPn)
